symptom: Healthy cloud users received temporary credential failures when source observations or database work consumed a short issuance window; failed renewals then interrupted turns and connections.
rule: The bug-fix playbook requires aged observations and per-query latency through the real router and PostgreSQL. Reuse exact confirmed source positives during temporary outages within the original bound; local execution must not require a live GitHub request. Network token mint and definitive revocation remain live.
